blocks.text: Sanya Lopez leads the comeback of FHM Philippines as its cover girl for the magazine’s November 2026 edition, marking the return of the men’s lifestyle brand under a new digital-first direction. Lopez was officially unveiled as the cover girl during FHM Philippines’ media launch in Parañaque on Friday evening, Nov. 6. The actress said she was proud to be part of the magazine’s return, emphasizing the importance of women empowerment and self-expression. “For me kasi, women empowerment talaga is important.
